body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: How the Nepal-Tibet disaster became the latest victim of China’s ‘Clean Internet’ campaign
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品

summary.en: The online campaign, which used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking, has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives. Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing...
summary.zh: 这场网络运动曾专注于打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但现已扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。46岁的藏族流亡者丹增·普措（Tsering...

body.en: The online campaign used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking but has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing family members on both sides of the border; those in Nepal are named in official government lists, but in Tibet he has received no information. “I have started praying for the lost ones now. I have to accept they will not return [because] … I’m not getting any information.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这场在线运动过去的重点是打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但后来扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。次仁平措在千里之外的印度南部观看了尼泊尔西藏洪水的新闻。 46岁流亡藏人在边境两侧都有家人失踪；尼泊尔的那些人被列入政府官方名单，但在西藏，他没有收到任何信息。 “我现在开始为失踪的人祈祷。我必须接受他们不会回来的事实，[因为]……我没有得到任何信息。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, Tsering Phuntsok faces a double tragedy: the potential loss of family members and the silencing of information. His inability to confirm their fate due to China's 'Clean Internet' campaign leaves him in agonizing uncertainty. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难之后，丹增·普措面临着双重悲剧：可能失去家人以及信息被噤声。由于中国“净网”运动，他无法确认家人的命运，这让他陷入痛苦的不确定之中。这种情况令人想起古老的呼吁：“为那些不能说话的人辩护，为所有贫困者伸张正义”（箴言31:8-9），敦促我们为那些声音被故意压制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: The US now has access to more than half Australia’s military bases – could it drag the country unwillingly into war?
title.zh: 美国现在可以进入澳大利亚一半以上的军事基地——这是否可能将该国不情愿地拖入战争？

summary.en: Exclusive reports reveal that US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to over 100 facilities across Australia. Some analysts liken this extensive presence to a 'colonisation' of Australia's military capabilities, with new data mapping the significant US militarisation on Australian soil.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露，美国控制的武器公司和部队在澳大利亚拥有超过100个设施的控制权或使用权。一些分析人士将这种广泛的存在比作对澳大利亚军事力量的“殖民化”，新的数据显示了澳大利亚本土美国军事化的程度。

body.en: Exclusive: US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to more than 100 facilities across the continent, which some analysts describe as a ‘colonisation’ of Australia’s military. Find a map of them here US military presence in Australia, mapped – video Why can the US access so many Australian military bases? – podcast US military interests control or have access to more than 100 defence facilities on Australian soil, in what some analysts describe as a “saturation” – even a “colonisation” – of the Australian continent. New data compiled by the Nautilus Institute and published by Guardian Australia maps the extent of US militarisation. The US military controls 17 facilities on mainland Australia and has access to 75 more Australian-run military installations. US defence corporations have access to an additional 18. Gathering intelligence, accessing satellite data for targeting information and communications intercepts. Training, including for 2,500 marines on dry-season rotation in the Northern Territory. Pre-positioning warfighting assets such as Osprey aircraft. Logistics hubs holding weapons, munitions and fuel, stored in case of a war in the Pacific. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The extensive US military presence across Australia, with access to over 100 facilities, raises profound questions about national sovereignty and the potential for entanglement in distant conflicts. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint, a hope for a world where military might is transformed into instruments of...
reflection.zh: 美国在澳大利亚广泛的军事存在，拥有超过100个设施的使用权，引发了关于国家主权和卷入遥远冲突的潜在问题的深刻疑问。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象提供了一个对照，一个关于军事力量被转化为和平与生产力工具的世界的希望。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China ‘colonises’ supply chains, industry warns
title.zh: 欧盟面临30万个工厂工作岗位流失，行业警告中国“殖民”供应链

summary.en: An industry trade body has warned that job losses in EU manufacturing will increase significantly unless Brussels addresses the "colonisation" of industry by Chinese component manufacturers. Eurometal forecasts 300,000 manufacturing job losses by the end of 2026 due to escalating competition from China, which...
summary.zh: 一家行业贸易机构警告称，除非布鲁塞尔解决中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民”问题，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将急剧增加。欧洲金属公司预测，到2026年底，由于来自中国的竞争加剧，制造业将损失30万个工作岗位，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差已达到创纪录的每日10亿欧元。

body.en: Protest using 10 coffins to symbolise struggling manufacturing industry to take place in Brussels Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers, a leading industry trade body has warned. Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一家领先的行业贸易机构警告说，除非布鲁塞尔停止中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民化”，否则布鲁塞尔将举行用十具棺材象征陷入困境的制造业的抗议活动，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将迅速增加。欧洲金属网预计，由于来自中国的竞争不断加剧，2026 年剩余时间制造业将有 30 万个就业岗位流失，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差每天达到创纪录的 10 亿欧元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning of 300,000 job losses in the EU manufacturing sector due to intense competition from China raises profound questions about economic justice and fairness. The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: China prepares £40bn stimulus for financial sector amid fears over sluggish growth
title.zh: 中国准备推出400亿英镑刺激措施以提振金融业，因担忧增长乏力

summary.en: Beijing plans to inject $54 billion (£40 billion) into its financial sector, aiming to support banks and insurers amidst concerns over faltering economic growth. The funds will come from state institutions and are intended to help replenish cash reserves and bolster investment in the stock market.
summary.zh: 北京计划向其金融业注入540亿美元（400亿英镑），旨在支持银行和保险公司应对经济增长乏力的问题。这笔资金将来自国家机构，用于补充现金储备并提振股市投资。

body.en: Beijing wants banks and insurers to bolster investment in stock market as it helps to replenish cash reserves China will inject $54bn (£40bn) into its financial sector as Beijing attempts to shore up banks and insurers in the face of faltering economic growth. A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北京希望银行和保险公司加强对股市的投资，以帮助补充现金储备 随着北京试图在经济增长放缓的情况下支撑银行和保险公司，中国将向其金融部门注资 540 亿美元（400 亿英镑）。许多金融机构表示，它们将从财政部甚至烟草专卖公司等国家机构获得数十亿元人民币的资金。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of economic headwinds, China is mobilizing significant capital to stabilize its financial markets. This action raises questions about the stewardship of national resources and the pursuit of economic justice. The prophet Micah reminds us that true governance involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that...
reflection.zh: 面对经济逆风，中国正动用巨额资金来稳定其金融市场。这一举措引发了关于国家资源管理和追求经济公正的疑问。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的治理在于秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行——这些原则为经济政策提供了永恒的标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: No bailouts for Jaguar Land Rover amid reports of thousands of job cuts, says minister
title.zh: 捷豹路虎面临裁员数千人的报道，部长称不会提供纾困金

summary.en: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), facing challenges from trade tariffs and domestic competitors, is reportedly planning up to 4,000 job cuts. The UK government has indicated it will not use taxpayer funds to prevent these layoffs, with the business secretary stating that intervening in business operations is not his role,...

body.en: Carmaker, which is battling Trump tariffs and Chinese competitors, faces talks with union leaders and government The government has signalled that it will not invest taxpayers’ money to limit job losses at Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), after it emerged that the UK’s biggest carmaker is planning up to 4,000 redundancies . Before crunch talks on Tuesday between JLR, union leaders and government officials, the business secretary, Jonathan Reynolds, said it was not his job to “intervene and run businesses”. Continue reading...

title.en: How Australia hopes to help the nation that's accused China of 'weaponising tourism'
title.zh: 中国被指控影响太平洋的方式出人意料

summary.en: As Palau faces renewed criticism from China, its president is seeking Australian assistance to diversify its primary economic source, tourism.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次面临中国的批评之际，其总统正寻求澳大利亚的援助，以实现其主要经济来源——旅游业的多元化。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don't need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They're harmless, Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: "This is my office", he declares.

It's in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders' meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of "theft" and "a dangerous local marine environment".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was "unfortunate" that Beijing was "weaponising tourism", an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

"We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other's treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that," Whipps said.

"Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other."

Palau's ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn't the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

"We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between," Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a "tourism ban". By 2019, Palau's total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Despite the CCP's efforts, Chinese visitors are slowly increasing post-pandemic, with many instead taking flights to Palau via Hong Kong.

"We've learned to be more resilient against these different shocks...

title.en: Can communities be protected from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 融化的冰川能保护社区免受灾害吗？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives. High mountain glaciers are retreating and becoming unstable as climate change causes them to melt, leading to events...
summary.zh: 不断上升的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以挽救生命的工具。高山冰川正在退缩并变得不稳定，因为气候变化导致它们融化，从而引发了8月26日尼泊尔和西藏的“山体海啸”等事件，威胁着数千人的生命。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些成分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of creation groaning under the weight of climate change. The melting glaciers and resulting 'mountain tsunamis' are not just environmental events, but signs of a world in distress, awaiting healing. As we witness these impacts, we are reminded of the deep interconnectedness of all things and the urgent...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的画面，显示受气候变化影响的受造界正在呻吟。融化的冰川和由此产生的“山体海啸”不仅仅是环境事件，更是世界痛苦的迹象，等待着治愈。当我们目睹这些影响时，我们被提醒万物之间深刻的相互联系，以及对关怀和修复的迫切需要。

This situation calls for wisdom and justice, as Micah 6:8 reminds us: to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. True solutions must address both the health goals and the ethical implications of policy.
reflection.zh: 通过税收追求公共健康，却产生了意想不到的后果：助长了非法市场和有组织犯罪。这种情况需要智慧和公义，正如弥迦书6:8所提醒我们的：“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”真正的解决方案必须同时解决健康目标和政策的伦理影响。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼有关联

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has stated that One Nation is not aligned with Germany's far-right party, the AfD, following the latter's significant win in a German state election. The AfD, classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence, faces isolation as other parties refuse to cooperate with them.
summary.zh: 在德国极右翼政党德国选择党（AfD）在一场州选举中取得显著胜利后，澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯表示，他的政党“一人党”（One Nation）与德国选择党无关。德国选择党被国内情报机构归类为“极右翼极端分子”，由于其他政党拒绝与其合作，该党在组建政府方面面临困难。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany party (AfD), after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold for advancing its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support to Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists: "Well, I don't see (the UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage) as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of global politics, leaders often face the challenge of defining their own identity and values, especially when confronted with the rise of extremist ideologies. Barnaby Joyce's clear rejection of association with the AfD highlights the importance of maintaining distinct political stances and seeking peaceful, constructive...
reflection.zh: 在全球政治的复杂格局中，领导人常常面临界定自身身份和价值观的挑战，尤其是在面对极端主义意识形态崛起之时。巴纳比·乔伊斯明确拒绝与德国选择党（AfD）产生关联，这凸显了保持政治立场独立性，并寻求和平、建设性交往的重要性，而非与分裂性的力量为伍。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'No choice': Grim interest rate warning for borrowers as oil prices spike
title.zh: 石油价格飙升，借款人面临严峻的利率警告

summary.en: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may need to increase interest rates if inflation proves higher than anticipated, driven by a surge in oil prices towards US$100 per barrel due to Middle East conflicts. Analysts predict higher oil prices for an extended period, suggesting the RBA will likely raise rates this month.
summary.zh: 由于中东冲突导致石油价格飙升至每桶100美元，澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）可能会在通胀高于预期的情况下提高利率。分析师预计油价将长期维持高位，这表明澳联储很可能在本月加息。

body.en:
The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) might have to raise interest rates if inflation is higher than expected as oil prices surge back towards US$100 a barrel.

More attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz drove Brent crude above US$97 a barrel, which will seep into domestic petrol and diesel prices and broader cost pressures for businesses.

Russel Chesler, VanEck's head of investments and capital markets, expects oil prices to stay higher for longer.

"The continuing Middle East conflict is showing no signs of a resolution and that will leave the RBA with no choice but to increase rates at its meeting later this month," he said.

RBA assistant governor Sarah Hunter did little to downplay expectations the bank would lift interest rates again if inflation continued to exceed its forecasts.

"I think the board has been pretty clear, and the staff as well. I'm certainly myself pretty clear that inflation is top priority right now," she told the AFR Property Summit in Sydney.

"We are concerned about inflation and if there is a sense that inflation is going to be stronger than we think in the context of our forecast, then the board may well have to raise interest rates to tackle that."

Both headline and trimmed mean inflation came in above the RBA's forecasts in July.

Ongoing price pressures from the Middle East conflict have been taking their toll on businesses, particularly in manufacturing, construction and retail, NAB head of Australian economics Gareth Spence said.

Business conditions took a tumble in August, with profitability falling 10 points to the lowest level since the pandemic, NAB's monthly business survey showed on Tuesday.

How much businesses are able to pass through those costs to consumers will help determine how sticky inflation will remain going forward.

Expectations of more rate rises caused sentiment among home owners to collapse in September, the Westpac-Melbourne Institute consumer sentiment index showed.

Confidence plummeted 14 per cent among mortgage holders in the month, compared to a 0.9 per cent fall among renters.

''Interest rate concerns had a clear negative impact on consumers with a mortgage," Westpac's head of Australian macro-forecasting Matthew Hassan said.

Overall, the consumer sentiment index declined 5.2 per cent to 84.4, as interest rate expectations climbed 7.3 per cent.

Despite economists forecasting the housing downturn to deepen as high interest rates combine with federal budget tax changes, only 32 per cent of consumers expected prices to decline over the next 12 months, with 42 per cent expecting a rise.

For many households already managing debt, the prospect of rising interest rates means a tightening grip, turning the abstract concept of financial obligation into a daily burden. title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Protesters call for Israeli ambassador's expulsion after Zomi Frankcom decision
title.zh: 抗议者呼吁驱逐以色列大使，此前对佐米·弗兰科姆事件做出裁决

summary.en: Activists gathered at the Israeli embassy in Canberra to protest the decision not to prosecute Israeli officers involved in the airstrike that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. Protesters displayed images of Palestinian casualties and chanted for the expulsion of Israel's ambassador.
summary.zh: 活动人士聚集在堪培拉的以色列大使馆，抗议一项决定，该决定不对以色列军官在加沙地带造成澳大利亚援助工作者佐米·弗兰科姆死亡的空袭事件进行起诉。抗议者展示了巴勒斯坦遇难者的照片，并高呼要求驱逐以色列大使。

body.en:
Dozens of activists have demanded Israel's ambassador in Canberra be expelled following the decision not to pursue criminal charges against officers who ordered strikes that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza.

The group converged in front of the Israeli embassy in Canberra on Tuesday displaying dozens of pictures of Palestinians killed by Israel since October 7 across the road from the embassy, with protesters chanting in unison: "Kick out the Israeli ambassador".

Israel's ambassador to Australia Hillel Newman last month declined to apologise to Zomi Frankcom’s family following the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) investigation which determined those responsible for the April 2024 strike that killed Frankcom and six of her colleagues would not be prosecuted.

Newman had said at the time he felt for the family but that the outcomes of Israel's investigation must be respected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A group called the Red Rebels staged a demonstration walking slowly to the embassy and pointing to its highly guarded gates, carrying a symbolic fake baby to represent the children killed by Israeli strikes in Gaza.

Activists blocked the entry to the embassy, leading police to physically move them from the driveway across the road. There was a tense standoff as protesters chanted "free Palestine" in front of a line of police officers.

Zomi's friend Karuna Bajracharya was among the protest group, saying he found remarks by one of the Israeli officers involved in the strike that he did not regret the attack as "disgusting".

Former IDF reserve colonel Nochi Mendel has told the ABC and the Guardian in separate interviews he would do "exactly the same thing" again and that he believed the World Central Kitchen workers killed were "not innocent".

"Like, disgusting the fact that he said, 'I'm not sorry', and the fact that he said he'd do it again.

"The people that we vote for and we put into power and that our taxes pay is supposed to represent us, the Australian people, and we are begging them: send this guy (the ambassador) home, send a clear message, cut the two-way arms trade. But it's obvious that our government is hamstrung."

Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi described the federal government as "cowards" for not declaring how it will proceed with its next steps to seek accountability over Frankcom’s death.

"They have power. They have responsibility, and we will hold them to account. They should have sanctioned Israel a long time ago," Faruqi told protesters.

"When Israel abrogated themselves of this crime, senator Wong told us how angry the Australian government was. Instead, they were considering what action to take...
body.zh: 数十名活动人士要求驱逐以色列驻堪培拉大使，此前以色列决定不对那些下令发动袭击并在加沙杀害澳大利亚援助人员佐米·弗兰克科姆的官员提出刑事指控。 周二，这群人聚集在堪培拉的以色列大使馆前，展示了数十张自 10 月 7 日以来在大使馆对面被以色列杀害的巴勒斯坦人的照片，抗议者齐声高呼：“赶走以色列大使”。 以色列驻澳大利亚大使希勒尔·纽曼 (Hillel Newman) 上个月拒绝向佐米·弗兰克科 (Zomi Frankcom) 的家人道歉，此前以色列国防军 (IDF) 进行了调查，确定对 2024 年 4 月导致弗兰克科 (Frankcom) 及其六名同事死亡的袭击负责的人不会受到起诉。 纽曼当时表示，他对这个家庭感到同情，但以色列的调查结果必须得到尊重。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一个名为“红色叛军”的组织举行示威活动，缓慢走向使馆，指着戒备森严的大门，并举着一个象征性的假婴儿，代表在以色列对加沙的袭击中丧生的儿童。 活动人士封锁了大使馆的入口，导致警察将他们从车道上移到马路对面。抗议者在一排警察面前高呼“自由巴勒斯坦”，双方陷入紧张的对峙。 佐米的朋友卡鲁纳·巴杰拉查里亚（Karuna Bajracharya）是抗议团体之一，他说，他发现参与袭击的一名以色列军官表示他并不后悔这次袭击的言论“令人作呕”。 前以色列国防军后备上校诺奇·门德尔在接受美国广播公司和卫报的单独采访时告诉美国广播公司和卫报，他会再次做“完全相同的事情”，并且他相信被杀害的世界中央厨房工人“不是无辜的”。 “就像，令人恶心的是，他说‘我不抱歉’，而且他说他会再这样做。 “我们投票支持、我们掌权的人，我们的纳税应该代表我们，澳大利亚人民，我们恳求他们：让这个人（大使）回家，发出明确的信息，削减双向武器贸易。但很明显，我们的政府已经陷入困境。” 绿党参议员梅林·法鲁奇 (Mehreen Faruqi) 称联邦政府是“懦夫”，因为他们没有宣布将如何采取下一步行动，追究弗兰克科姆之死的责任。 “他们有权力。他们有责任，我们将追究他们的责任。他们早就应该制裁以色列了，”法鲁奇告诉抗议者。 “当以色列废除这一罪行时，黄参议员告诉我们澳大利亚政府有多么愤怒。相反，他们正在考虑采取什么行动......

reflection.en: The demand for accountability following the death of Zomi Frankcom highlights a deep human yearning for justice. When official channels seem to fail, people often turn to public protest, seeking a flow of righteousness that addresses suffering and holds power accountable. May all parties seek paths toward true justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 在佐米·弗兰科姆去世后，人们对问责的呼吁凸显了人类对正义的深切渴望。当官方渠道似乎失效时，人们常常诉诸公众抗议，寻求一种能够解决苦难并追究权力责任的公义之流。愿各方都能寻求通往真正正义与和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Anthony Albanese says he's not trying to stop you from doomscrolling
title.zh: 总理说他不想阻止你“末日刷屏”

summary.en: New laws proposed in Australia could give internet users the choice to opt out of algorithmic recommendations on social media, allowing them to control their online feeds under an initiative called 'My Feed, My Way'.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚提议的新法律可能让互联网用户选择退出社交媒体上的算法推荐，让他们在“我的信息流，我的方式”倡议下控制自己的在线信息流。

body.en:
Australian internet users will be given the choice to opt out of algorithmic recommendations   under proposed social media reforms.

Draft laws setting up a digital duty of care were introduced by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Tuesday.

As part of the measures, social media companies will need to provide tools for people to choose what they see in their online feeds, under a government initiative called My Feed, My Way.

Social media companies have been accused of creating addictive algorithms that keep people endlessly scrolling through recommended content. Advocates have called for a reversion to chronological feeds that show posts from friends and other accounts a user follows.

"This is not about giving government control. It's about giving people control. It's about putting choice back into the hands of Australians online," Albanese told reporters in Canberra.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"If people want to doom scroll, as you call it, that's fine, that's up to them," he said.

"But if people want to have a change, then this will provide them with the opportunity."

He pointed to global discussion over harms linked to social media, including at the United Nations.

"It's a debate that's taking place in countries all around the world, because of the sort of impact that we're seeing," he added, citing a rise in mental health issues and eating disorders as examples.

The reforms had drawn backlash from both the Coalition and Greens before being formally announced, with Opposition leader Angus Taylor suggesting it could be akin to censorship.

Meanwhile, Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young called for the opt-out algorithm to be made the default setting.

Under the draft laws, social media companies will also be required to protect people from harmful content online.

Harmful content will include the promotion of eating disorders, misogynistic content, pornography or content that glorifies crime.

Albanese said the legislation would empower the government to issue removal notices for 'nudify' apps and websites, which typically use artificial intelligence to create fake nude images of people without their consent.

Sharing that type of content — nonconsensual deepfake sexualised images — is already illegal in much of Australia, but developing the tools to do so isn't.

Companies could face fines of $100 million if they don't enact the duty of care.

Communications Minister Anika Wells said the duty of care would build on the world-leading ban on social media for under-16s Australia introduced last year.

"The digital duty of care is not about controlling adults online. It is about giving adults a choice," she said.

This proposed Australian law aims to give users agency over their digital environment, encouraging a more intentional engagement with online information. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure,...
reflection.zh: 社交媒体上不断涌现的精选内容可能导致无休止的滚动，这通常被称为“末日刷屏”。澳大利亚这项提议的法律旨在让用户掌控自己的数字环境，鼓励更有意识地参与在线信息。腓立比书4:8提醒我们要思念地上“凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的”，这些都可作为我们线上和线下选择的指导原则。

title.en: Former CE Tung Chee-hwa dies at 89
title.zh: 前特首董建華逝世，享年89歲

summary.en: Former Hong Kong Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa has passed away at the age of 89. His office confirmed his peaceful death on Tuesday, surrounded by family. The statement highlighted his lifelong dedication to serving the nation and noted that his legacy endures. Tung was the first chief executive of the Hong Kong...
summary.zh: 香港前行政長官董建華昨日（週二）在家人的陪伴下安詳離世，享年89歲。他的辦公室發布聲明，指董建華畢生致力於服務國家，其精神遺澤永存。董建華於1997年至2005年間擔任香港特別行政區首任行政長官，之後擔任中國人民政治協商會議全國委員會副主席。

body.en: Former chief executive Tung Chee-hwa has died at the age of 89. His office said Tung passed away peacefully on Tuesday, surrounded by family members. The statement added that he dedicated his life to serving the nation, and his legacy lives on. Tung served as the SAR's first chief executive from 1997 to 2005. He later served as vice chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Edited by Cecil Wong
body.zh: 前行政长官董建华去世，享年 89 岁。他的办公室表示，董建华于周二在家人的陪伴下安详离世。声明还说，他一生致力于为国家服务，他的遗产将继续存在。董建华于1997年至2005年担任香港特别行政区第一任行政长官，其后担任中国人民政治协商会议副主席。黄塞西尔编辑

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that it is appointed for man to die once. As we reflect on a life dedicated to public service, we are reminded of the finite nature of our time on earth and the enduring legacy that follows.
reflection.zh: 董建華先生以89歲高齡離世的消息，提醒我們死亡是人類共同的經歷。希伯來書9章27節指出，人人都有一死。在我們回顧他為公眾服務的一生時，也應銘記生命短暫，而身後留下的影響則會延續。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, dies aged 89

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human journey toward mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that death comes to all. In this moment, we acknowledge the end of a significant public life and reflect on the finite nature of our own time.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世的消息，提醒我们所有人终将面对的生命终点。希伯来书9章27节指出，人人都有一死，这是人类共同的命运。此刻，我们缅怀一位重要公众人物的生命历程，并反思我们自己生命的有限。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Hong Kong students drop in global rankings for maths, science and literacy
title.zh: 香港学生在数学、科学和读写能力全球排名下降

summary.en: Hong Kong secondary school students have seen their performance decline in an international assessment covering three key subjects, with their science scores falling out of the global top 10 for the first time. Experts attribute this drop, partly to the post-Covid impact on study habits and learning motivation.
summary.zh: 香港中学生在涵盖三个核心科目的国际评估中的表现有所下降，其中科学成绩更是首次跌出全球前十名。专家认为，这一下降部分归因于新冠疫情后对学习习惯和学习动力的影响。

body.en: Hong Kong secondary school students’ performance has fallen in an international assessment focused on three core subjects, with their science score dropping out of the global top 10 for the first time in the study’s history. Experts said on Tuesday that the decline in Hong Kong scores in the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa) was partly due to the post-Covid impact on study habits and learning motivation. Held every three years, Pisa is a worldwide study by the Organisation...
body.zh: 在一项针对三门核心科目的国际评估中，香港中学生的成绩出现下滑，其中科学成绩在该研究历史上首次跌出全球前十名。专家周二表示，香港在国际学生评估计划（Pisa）中的分数下降，部分原因是疫情后对学习习惯和学习动机的影响。比萨每三年举行一次，是该组织的一项全球性研究......

reflection.en: The decline in Hong Kong students' scores in international assessments is a concerning sign, suggesting a potential weakening of foundational learning. Proverbs 1:7 reminds us that true knowledge begins with reverence and a commitment to foundational principles, urging a return to the core of education.
reflection.zh: 香港学生在国际评估中的分数下降是一个令人担忧的迹象，表明基础学习可能正在削弱。《箴言》1:7提醒我们，真正的知识始于敬畏和对基本原则的承诺，敦促我们回归教育的核心。

verse.textEn: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verse.textZh: 敬畏雅伟是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

title.en: Contractors will bear repair costs for lift defects at Queen Mary Hospital, Hong Kong development chief says
title.zh: 香港发展局局长称皇后码头医院电梯缺陷的维修费用将由承包商承担

summary.en: Hong Kong's development chief has stated that government contractors will be responsible for the full repair costs of faulty elevator work in a redeveloped building at Queen Mary Hospital, which led to tilted elevator shafts. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn also indicated that the government reserves the...
summary.zh: 香港发展局局长表示，皇后码头医院一栋重建建筑中存在缺陷的电梯工程的全部维修费用将由政府承包商承担，这些工程导致电梯井道倾斜。发展局局长林郑月娥周二还表示，政府保留向负责缺陷工程的承包商和分包商寻求赔偿的权利，该工程已导致港岛最大公立医院临床大楼一号楼的全面重新开放延迟。

body.en: Hong Kong’s development chief has said that government contractors will bear the full repair costs for faulty lift work in a redeveloped building at Queen Mary Hospital that resulted in tilted elevator shafts. Queen Mary Hospital. File photo: GovHK. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn also said on Tuesday that the government reserves the right to seek compensation from the contractors and subcontractors responsible for the defective work, which has delayed the full reopening of Clinical Block 1 at the largest public hospital on Hong Kong Island. Linn confirmed on Tuesday that the external walls of the building’s elevator shafts had structural “errors,” following media reports that revealed the defects last week. “The errors may have left insufficient room for elevators to operate smoothly inside the buildings,” Linn told reporters in Cantonese, adding that some lift components were installed “improperly.” The Hong Kong Economic Times first reported on the structural defect last week, with unnamed sources saying that the new elevator shafts had a “rhombus” shape that they likened to Italy’s leaning Tower of Pisa. Linn said on Tuesday that the contractors were confident that the defects could be fixed in the final quarter of this year. Proper disclosure in due course She also defended a piecemeal-style disclosure process employed by various government departments regarding the issue, saying that full transparency at this stage could lead to legal disputes in the future. Hong Kong Development Secretary Bernadette Linn addresses the Legislative Council on January 14, 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department – the two governmental departments with direct oversight in the incident – have been criticised for a lack of transparency regarding the structural defects. “Precisely because there could be contractual claims to be made later, it is undesirable to publicly discuss every detail at this stage… so as not to affect the government’s right to make compensation claims,” Linn said. She pledged that proper disclosures would be made in due course. Linn added that the government will also review whether the two departments can improve their inspection and acceptance procedures. The Development Bureau said last week that it had requested the two departments submit reports regarding the incident and minimise further delays to Queen Mary Hospital’s redevelopment work.
body.zh: 香港发展负责人表示，政府承包商将承担玛丽医院重建大楼电梯故障导致电梯井倾斜的全部维修费用。玛丽皇后医院。资料图片：香港政府一站通。发展局局长林恩周二还表示，政府保留向对工程缺陷负责的承包商和分包商寻求赔偿的权利，该工程导致港岛最大公立医院一期临床大楼全面重新开放的时间被推迟。继上周媒体报道披露了这些缺陷后，林恩周二证实，该建筑电梯井的外墙存在结构“错误”。林恩用粤语告诉记者：“这些错误可能导致电梯在建筑物内平稳运行的空间不足。”他补充说，一些电梯部件安装“不当”。香港经济日报上周首次报道了这一结构缺陷，未透露姓名的消息人士称，新电梯井呈“菱形”形状，他们将其比作意大利的比萨斜塔。林恩周二表示，承包商有信心在今年最后一个季度修复这些缺陷。适时适当披露 她还为各政府部门就该问题采用的零敲碎打式披露程序进行了辩护，称现阶段的完全透明可能会导致未来的法律纠纷。香港发展局局长林贝尔纳黛于 2026 年 1 月 14 日在立法会发表讲话。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。建筑署和机电工程署这两个直接监管该事件的政府部门因结构缺陷缺乏透明度而受到批评。 “正是因为以后可能会提出合同索赔，所以现阶段不宜公开讨论每一个细节……以免影响政府提出赔偿要求的权利，”林恩说。她承诺将在适当的时候进行适当的披露。林恩补充说，政府还将审查这两个部门是否可以改进其检查和验收程序。发展局上周表示，已要求两部门就事件提交报告，尽量减少对玛丽医院重建工作的进一步延误。

reflection.en: When construction projects go awry, as with the tilted elevator shafts at Queen Mary Hospital, the question of accountability arises. The development chief's statement that contractors will bear the costs underscores the importance of ethical responsibility in public works. This echoes Micah 6:8, which calls for justice and accountability, reminding us that...
reflection.zh: 当建筑工程出现问题时，例如皇后码头医院的电梯井道倾斜，问责制的问题就随之而来。发展局局长关于承包商将承担费用的声明，强调了公共工程中道德责任的重要性。这呼应了弥迦书6章8节所呼吁的公义和问责，提醒我们，在我们的交易中，尤其是在影响公众福祉的交易中，诚信是至关重要的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Global innovation index recognises GBA's strengths'
title.zh: 全球创新指数认可大湾区优势

summary.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster has maintained its top position in the latest Global Innovation Index, reaffirming the Greater Bay Area's comprehensive innovation strength. This success is seen as a reflection of Hong Kong's research capabilities and the increasing collaboration between Hong Kong and mainland...
summary.zh: 最新的全球创新指数显示，深圳—香港—广州集群保持了其首位，重申了大湾区全面的创新实力。根据香港思汇政策研究所的说法，这一成功反映了香港的研究能力以及香港与大湾区内地城市日益增长的合作。

body.en: Local think tank Our Hong Kong Foundation said the latest Global Innovation Index, of which the Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retained the top spot, reaffirmed the comprehensive innovation strength of the Greater Bay Area. The result was published by the World Intellectual Property Organisation on Tuesday. “It reflects not only Hong Kong’s distinctive strengths in basic research, but also the sustained recognition by an authoritative international institution of closer I&T collaboration in recent years between Hong Kong and mainland GBA cities,” the foundation's deputy research director Victor Kwok said. He said China leads all nations with the most clusters in the ranking for the fourth straight year – showcasing the effectiveness of its policies in science, technology and innovation. The SAR should lure more global I&T investment to the city and the GBA through the government's HK$10 billion innovation fund and its international capital networks, Kwok added. Meanwhile, DAB lawmaker Elizabath Quat said the result showed that the GBA has already formed a complete innovation ecosystem encompassing research, transformation and capital. She said that moving forward, deepening cooperation between Hong Kong and other GBA cities will boost the nation's overall I&T development. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 本地智库团结香港基金会表示，最新的全球创新指数中，深港广集群蝉联榜首，再次肯定了大湾区的综合创新实力。世界知识产权组织周二公布了这一结果。该基金会副研究总监郭伟表示：“这不仅反映了香港在基础研究方面的独特优势，也体现了国际权威机构对香港与大湾区内地城市近年来更加紧密的创科合作的持续认可。”他表示，中国连续第四年在集群数量最多的国家排名中名列前茅，显示了其科技创新政策的有效性。郭补充说，特区应通过政府100亿港元的创新基金及其国际资本网络，吸引更多全球科技投资到香港和大湾区。与此同时，民建联议员Elizabath Quat表示，这一结果表明，大湾区已经形成了涵盖研究、转化和资本的完整创新生态系统。她表示，展望未来，香港与大湾区其他城市深化合作将推动国家整体创科发展。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster's continued leadership in innovation is a testament to focused effort and collaboration. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that committing our plans and work to Yahweh is key to their success. May this achievement inspire continued dedication and wisdom in pursuing innovation for the common good.
reflection.zh: 深圳—香港—广州集群在创新领域持续领先，是专注努力和协作的证明。箴言16:3提醒我们，将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟是成功的关键。愿这一成就激励人们继续致力于创新，以促进共同福祉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: China’s top court posts guidelines on deepfakes, voice cloning, algorithmic price discrimination
title.zh: 中国最高法院发布关于深度伪造、声音克隆和算法价格歧视的指南

summary.en: China's Supreme People's Court has released new guidelines addressing emerging issues in artificial intelligence, including the unauthorized creation and distribution of deepfakes and cloned voices, as well as algorithmic price discrimination. These guidelines aim to provide legal clarity for AI-related disputes...
summary.zh: 中国最高人民法院发布了新的指导方针，以应对人工智能领域出现的新问题，包括未经授权的深度伪造和声音克隆，以及算法价格歧视。这些指导方针旨在为中国境内与人工智能相关的纠纷提供法律清晰度。

body.en: China’s top court issued guidelines on Monday covering a range of emerging pitfalls associated with artificial intelligence, including unauthorised deepfakes and voice cloning, state media reported. The Supreme People’s Court in Beijing. File photo: GovCN. The move provides judicial guidance for AI-related disputes in China, which is currently engaged in an intense competition with the United States for dominance in the key technology. The guidelines released by the Supreme People’s Court “make clear that people cannot use AI to create or distribute recognisable digital replicas of others without their consent, including cloned faces and voices”, state news agency Xinhua reported. Other disputes targeted include “algorithmic price discrimination and AI-generated false information”, Xinhua said. Recent years have seen widespread adoption of AI technologies that allow individual users to easily create content that convincingly replicates the appearance and voices of real humans. Chinese authorities have invested heavily in domestic AI, seeking to build up the country’s prowess in the increasingly crucial sector. But President Xi Jinping has also warned of potential dangers, urging attendees at a conference in July to “strengthen risk-awareness and ensure that AI is secure and controllable”. Chinese President Xi Jinping attends a China-US bilateral meeting at the Gimhae International Airport terminal, in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Under the new rules, service providers can be found legally liable if they fail to “take timely action” once notified that their systems have generated content infringing on others’ rights, Xinhua reported. The guidelines offer legal recourse for “someone whose face has been digitally altered and used to spread false and defamatory sexual claims”, it added. The court’s Vice President Tao Kaiyuan said that the guidelines seek to “balance development and security”, according to a transcript of a press conference on Monday published on the court’s website. They seek to clarify rules for procedural matters in AI-related disputes, said Tao. “For issues where consensus is currently difficult to reach, (the guidelines) leave room for clarification, allowing for further experience accumulation and appropriate clarification when conditions are ripe,” she added.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国最高法院周一发布了指导方针，涵盖了一系列与人工智能相关的新兴陷阱，包括未经授权的深度伪造和声音克隆。北京最高人民法院。资料图片：GovCN。此举为目前与美国争夺关键技术主导地位的中国人工智能相关纠纷提供了司法指导。据官方通讯社新华社报道，最高人民法院发布的指导意见“明确规定，未经他人同意，不得使用人工智能创建或传播他人可识别的数字复制品，包括克隆面孔和声音”。新华社称，其他针对的争议包括“算法价格歧视和人工智能生成的虚假信息”。近年来，人工智能技术得到广泛采用，个人用户可以轻松创建令人信服地复制真人外观和声音的内容。中国当局在国内人工智能领域投入巨资，寻求在这个日益重要的领域增强国家实力。但习近平主席也对潜在危险发出警告，敦促与会者“强化风险意识，确保人工智能安全可控”。 2025 年 10 月 30 日，中国国家主席习近平在韩国釜山金海国际机场航站楼出席中美双边会议。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。据新华社报道，根据新规定，服务提供商如果在得知其系统生成了侵犯他人权利的内容后未能“及时采取行动”，可能会被追究法律责任。它补充说，该指南为“面部经过数字化改造并用于传播虚假和诽谤性言论的人”提供了法律追索权。根据法院网站周一发布的新闻发布会文字记录，法院副院长陶开元表示，该指导方针旨在“平衡发展与安全”。陶说，他们寻求澄清人工智能相关争议中的程序问题规则。 “对于目前难以达成共识的问题，（指南）留有澄清的空间，以便进一步积累经验，并在条件成熟时进行适当的澄清。”她补充道。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, the potential for misuse, such as creating convincing deepfakes and cloned voices, grows. The Supreme People's Court's guidelines highlight the need for ethical boundaries in technology, reminding us of the biblical call to speak truth and avoid deception, ensuring our words and creations reflect integrity. In a...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，滥用的可能性，例如制造逼真的深度伪造和克隆声音，也在增加。中国最高人民法院的指导方针强调了在技术领域设定道德界限的必要性，提醒我们圣经呼吁要说诚实话，避免欺骗，确保我们的言语和创作反映出正直。在一个数字复制品可以轻易伪造的世界里，真实沟通和诚实呈现的价值变得更加重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.zh: 香港电视32台晚间新闻 - 9月8日

reflection.en: When public projects falter, as seen with the oversized lifts at Queen Mary Hospital, it raises questions about accountability and the integrity of oversight. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves not just grand pronouncements but the humble practice of justice and mercy in all our dealings, especially those that affect the public good.

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou retains crown as world’s top innovation hub
title.zh: 深港广携手，连续两年蝉联全球创新中心桂冠

summary.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster has been recognized as the world's leading innovation hub for the second consecutive year, according to the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization. This achievement reaffirms the region's strength in innovation, surpassing other...
summary.zh: 根据世界知识产权组织发布的《2026年全球创新指数》，深圳-香港-广州集群连续第二年被评为世界领先的创新中心。这一成就重申了该地区在创新方面的实力，超越了东京-横滨和首尔等其他主要中心。

body.en: A cluster comprising Hong Kong and two mainland Chinese cities has been ranked the world’s top innovation hub for the second consecutive year by a United Nations body. The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retained its crown in the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization on Tuesday. Tokyo-Yokohama, San Jose-San Francisco, Seoul and Beijing followed in the rankings. A government spokesman welcomed the ranking, saying it reaffirmed the Greater Bay...
body.zh: 由香港和中国大陆两个城市组成的集群连续第二年被联合国机构评为世界顶级创新中心。世界知识产权组织周二发布的2026年全球创新指数中，深港广集群蝉联冠军。东京-横滨、圣何塞-旧金山、首尔和北京紧随其后。政府发言人对这一排名表示欢迎，称其再次肯定了大湾区...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of knowledge and technology is a hallmark of our age, as noted in Daniel's prophecy. This cluster's continued success is a testament to human ingenuity and collaboration. May this innovation be guided by wisdom and a commitment to serving humanity.
reflection.zh: 知识和技术的飞速发展是我们这个时代的标志，正如但以理的预言所指出的。这一集群的持续成功证明了人类的创造力和协作精神。愿这些创新能以智慧和致力于服务人类的精神为指导。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学
