strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Quebec wildfire smoke left forest moths with deformed wings, research finds
title.zh: 研究发现魁北克野火烟雾导致森林飞蛾翅膀畸形

summary.en: Quebec experienced its worst wildfire season in 2023, burning 4.5 million hectares of boreal forest. A new study by Concordia researchers is one of the first to examine the impact of wildfire smoke on the development of winged insects, finding that smoke exposure led to deformed wings in forest moths.
summary.zh: 2023年，魁北克经历了有记录以来最严重的野火季，烧毁了450万公顷的北方森林。康考迪亚大学研究人员的一项新研究首次探讨了野火烟雾对有翅昆虫发育的影响，发现烟雾暴露导致森林飞蛾翅膀畸形。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Over the course of the summer of 2023, Quebec experienced its worst wildfire season on record. By its end, some 4.5 million hectares (11.1 million acres) of the province's boreal forest had burned. While the effects of the toxic smoke on humans have been thoroughly studied, our knowledge of the impact on local fauna—including insects—is lacking.

A new study led by Concordia researchers is among the first to look at how exposure to wildfire smoke affects the development of Lepidoptera: the order of winged insects that includes moths and butterflies.

The paper, published in the journal Environmental Science and Pollution Research , shows that smoke exposure during larval development caused significantly higher rates of wing deformities in spruce budworm and forest tent caterpillar moths, two species that periodically strip the leaves off millions of hectares of Canadian forest when the insects' populations boom.

"These insects are important because they are considered pests, meaning they have outbreak seasons when the population density becomes very high," says Rosa Alicia Castillo Salazar, MSc student and co-author. "We do not yet know how forest fires and climate change will affect them in the long term. However, there was no significant change in their population the following year."

Smoke-exposed spruce budworm moths were twice as likely to develop wings that the researchers classified as folded, crumpled or missing. Roughly 30% of the larvae collected post-fire exhibited wing malformations, compared with roughly 11% to 15% from the previous year.

Forest tent caterpillars showed a similar pattern, though males appeared to have been disproportionately affected, with more malformations and reduced flight activity than clean-air lab and field samples collected later.

Pheromone field traps, which captured only moths that could fly, yielded fewer moths with damaged wings, suggesting that the deformities impaired flight.

The researchers had already been collecting spruce budworm larvae and monitoring forest tent caterpillar populations in the province's Abitibi region for unrelated projects when surging fires forced them indoors. That interruption effectively split their samples into "before" and "after" smoke exposure, which the team used to compare wing morphology, body mass and flight capacity.

The exact mechanism connecting smoke to wing malformation also remains unclear, but they speculate that it may have to do with hormonal disruption during metamorphosis or altered breathing habits resulting from poor air quality.

Oddly, moths with deformed wings of both...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2023 年夏季，魁北克经历了有记录以来最严重的野火季节。截至年底，该省约 450 万公顷（1110 万英亩）的北方森林已被烧毁。虽然有毒烟雾对人类的影响已得到彻底研究，但我们对其对当地动物群（包括昆虫）的影响仍缺乏了解。 康科迪亚大学研究人员领导的一项新研究是首批研究暴露于野火烟雾如何影响鳞翅目昆虫（包括飞蛾和蝴蝶）发育的研究之一。 这篇发表在《环境科学与污染研究》杂志上的论文表明，幼虫发育过程中接触烟雾会导致云杉芽虫和森林帐篷毛虫蛾翅膀畸形率显着升高，这两种昆虫在昆虫数量激增时，会定期从加拿大数百万公顷的森林中剥落叶子。 “这些昆虫很重要，因为它们被认为是害虫，这意味着当种群密度变得非常高时，它们就会出现爆发季节，”理学硕士生兼合著者罗莎·艾丽西亚·卡斯蒂略·萨拉查 (Rosa Alicia Castillo Salazar) 说。 “我们还不知道森林火灾和气候变化将如何长期影响它们。但是，第二年它们的数量没有显着变化。” 暴露在烟雾中的云杉芽蛾长出翅膀的可能性是研究人员分类为折叠、皱缩或缺失的翅膀的两倍。火灾后收集的幼虫中大约有 30% 表现出翅膀畸形，而去年这一比例约为 11% 至 15%。 森林帐篷毛虫也表现出类似的模式，尽管雄性似乎受到了不成比例的影响，与后来收集的清洁空气实验室和野外样本相比，畸形更多，飞行活动减少。 信息素田间诱捕器只捕获能够飞行的飞蛾，但翅膀受损的飞蛾数量较少，这表明这些畸形影响了飞行。 研究人员已经在该省阿比蒂比地区收集云杉芽虫幼虫并监测森林帐篷毛毛虫的数量，以进行不相关的项目，当时汹涌的大火迫使他们呆在室内。这种中断有效地将他们的样本分为烟雾暴露“之前”和“之后”，研究小组用它们来比较机翼形态、体重和飞行能力。 将烟雾与翅膀畸形联系起来的确切机制仍不清楚，但他们推测这可能与变态过程中的荷尔蒙破坏或空气质量差导致的呼吸习惯改变有关。 奇怪的是，飞蛾的翅膀都变形了……

reflection.en: The smoke from Quebec's devastating 2023 wildfires, which scorched millions of acres, has had a visible, physical impact on the province's smallest inhabitants. The deformed wings of forest moths serve as a poignant, tangible sign of how environmental damage affects the intricate web of life. This echoes the biblical description of creation itself groaning...
reflection.zh: 2023年魁北克毁灭性的野火季烧毁了数百万英亩土地，其产生的烟雾对该省最小的居民造成了可见的、物理上的影响。森林飞蛾畸形的翅膀成为了环境破坏影响生命复杂网络的一个令人痛心的、有形的标志。这呼应了圣经中关于受造界本身在败坏和扰乱的重压下叹息，等待更新的描述。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Star-fingered toads use fingertip lobules to detect prey in murky water
title.zh: 星形手指蟾蜍用指尖小叶在浑浊的水中探测猎物

summary.en: Surinam toads (Pipa pipa), known for their flat bodies, minuscule eyes, and unique egg-carrying method on their backs, inhabit the murky Amazon basin. Their hunting strategy involves lying in wait with outstretched forelimbs, then creating suction with their jaws to rapidly draw in and swallow small fish. This...
summary.zh: 苏里南蟾蜍（Pipa pipa）是一种奇特的扁平蛙类，拥有微小的眼睛，生活在亚马逊盆地的浑浊水域中，并将卵背在背上。它们的捕食方式更为奇特：它们会伸出前肢静待，一旦有小鱼靠近，便迅速张开嘴制造吸力，将鱼吸入口中并整个吞下。这种适应性使它们能在低能见度下进行捕猎。

body.en: Surinam toads (Pipa pipa) are strange, flat frogs with minuscule eyes that live in the murky waters of the Amazon basin and carry their eggs on their backs. The way they catch prey is even weirder. They lie in wait with outstretched forelimbs until a small fish approaches, then snap open their jaws to create enough suction to draw the fish into their tongueless mouths and swallow it whole, all in a few hundredths of a second. But how do these frogs hunt in low visibility with poor vision?
body.zh: 苏里南蟾蜍（Pipa pipa）是一种奇怪的扁平青蛙，眼睛很小，生活在亚马逊河流域的浑浊水域中，背上产卵。它们捕捉猎物的方式更加奇怪。它们伸出前肢等待，直到一条小鱼靠近，然后猛地张开下巴，产生足够的吸力，将鱼吸入它们无舌的嘴里，并将其整个吞下，这一切都在百分之几秒内完成。但这些青蛙如何在能见度低、视力不佳的情况下捕猎呢？

reflection.en: The Surinam toad's 'star-fingered' anatomy is a marvel of adaptation, allowing it to navigate and hunt in the low-visibility conditions of the Amazon basin. This intricate design, a testament to the Creator's wisdom, reminds us that even in the most challenging environments, life finds remarkable ways to thrive. Observing such specialized adaptations in...
reflection.zh: 苏里南蟾蜍的“星形手指”构造是一种令人惊叹的适应性进化，使它能在亚马逊盆地浑浊的环境中导航和捕猎。这种精巧的设计，是造物主智慧的明证，提醒我们即使在最具挑战性的环境中，生命也能找到非凡的生存之道。观察自然界中如此特殊的适应性，能让我们更深刻地体会到生命本身所蕴含的深邃智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New molecular magnet design boosts performance for ultrahigh-density data storage
title.zh: 新型分子磁体设计提升超高密度数据存储性能

summary.en: Researchers at The University of Manchester and the Australian National University have developed a new class of molecular magnets that combines the most successful features of previous designs, resulting in some of the strongest magnetic memory properties reported to date.
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特大学和澳大利亚国立大学的研究人员开发了一类新型分子磁体，它结合了先前设计的成功特性，实现了迄今为止最强的磁性记忆特性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at The University of Manchester and the Australian National University have developed a new class of molecular magnets that combines the most successful features of previous designs, resulting in some of the strongest magnetic memory properties reported to date.

The work, published in Nature Communications , centers on single-molecule magnets (SMMs), a class of materials capable of storing magnetic information within individual molecules. These materials are being explored as candidates for future ultrahigh-density data storage technologies, as they offer the potential for information to be stored on a dramatically smaller scale than in conventional magnetic devices.

Controlling the geometry of lanthanide compounds has long been one of the major challenges in molecular magnet design. The researchers have overcome part of that challenge by combining two molecular architectures that had previously delivered strong, but different, magnetic properties.

"The best single-molecule magnets reported over the past decade have tended to excel in different areas. Our goal was to bring the most successful features of these designs together in a single molecule. By carefully controlling the structure around the dysprosium center, we've produced materials that perform strongly across several key measures of magnetic memory," said Professor David Mills, professor of inorganic chemistry at The University of Manchester.

The international team, led by Mills at Manchester and Professor Nicholas Chilton at the Australian National University, combined cyclopentadienyl ligands, which help create rigid molecular structures, with amide ligands, which form particularly short dysprosium-nitrogen bonds. The resulting molecules adopted near-linear structures with ligand angles approaching 172°, a geometry believed to contribute in part to their exceptional magnetic behavior.

Alongside magnetic hysteresis temperatures of up to 92 K, the new materials were able to store magnetic information for 100 seconds at temperatures up to 40 K, indicating significantly improved magnetic memory retention compared with earlier dysprosium-amide systems.

Mills continued, "Controlling the geometries of lanthanide compounds is notoriously difficult as the chemical bonding is nondirectional. Therefore, although near-linear dysprosium compounds have long been predicted to give the best SMMs, we are only now able to use carefully selected combinations of ligands to consistently deliver these target molecules."

The ability to create SMMs with magnetic memory effects at higher temperatures widens the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 曼彻斯特大学和澳大利亚国立大学的研究人员开发了一种新型分子磁体，它结合了以前设计中最成功的功能，从而产生了迄今为止报道的最强的磁记忆特性。 这项发表在《自然通讯》上的研究以单分子磁体（SMM）为中心，这是一类能够在单个分子内存储磁性信息的材料。这些材料正在被探索作为未来超高密度数据存储技术的候选材料，因为它们提供了以比传统磁性设备小得多的规模存储信息的潜力。 控制稀土化合物的几何形状长期以来一直是分子磁体设计的主要挑战之一。研究人员通过结合两种先前具有强但不同磁性特性的分子结构，克服了部分挑战。 曼彻斯特大学无机化学教授 David Mills 表示：“过去十年报道的最好的单分子磁体往往在不同领域表现出色。我们的目标是将这些设计最成功的功能整合到一个分子中。通过仔细控制镝中心周围的结构，我们生产出了在磁记忆的几个关键指标上表现强劲的材料。” 由曼彻斯特的米尔斯和澳大利亚国立大学的尼古拉斯·奇尔顿教授领导的国际团队将有助于创建刚性分子结构的环戊二烯基配体与形成特别短的镝氮键的酰胺配体结合起来。由此产生的分子采用近线性结构，配体角度接近 172°，这种几何形状被认为在一定程度上促成了其卓越的磁性行为。 除了高达 92 K 的磁滞温度之外，新材料还能够在高达 40 K 的温度下存储磁性信息 100 秒，这表明与早期的镝酰胺系统相比，磁记忆保留能力显着提高。 Mills 继续说道：“众所周知，控制镧系化合物的几何形状非常困难，因为化学键合是无方向性的。因此，尽管长期以来人们就预测近线性镝化合物可以提供最好的 SMM，但我们现在只能使用精心挑选的配体组合来一致地传递这些目标分子。” 在较高温度下创建具有磁记忆效应的 SMM 的能力拓宽了……

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge through scientific inquiry reveals the intricate wonders of creation. This new development in molecular magnets, born from dedicated research, showcases humanity's capacity to understand and harness the principles Yahweh has embedded in the physical world. It is a testament to the wisdom found when we observe and learn from the...
reflection.zh: 科学探索对知识的追求揭示了被造界的精妙奇迹。这项在分子磁体方面的新发展源于不懈的研究，展示了人类理解和利用雅伟已嵌入物质世界原则的能力。当我们观察并学习周围的宇宙时，它证明了其中蕴含的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Too hot to learn: How climate change hurts children's chances from birth
title.zh: 太热无法学习：气候变化如何影响儿童从出生起的机遇

summary.en: Children across Europe have returned to school after a summer of extreme heat. As the climate warms, one question is becoming harder to ignore: How can students learn when classrooms become dangerously hot? Climate change can influence a child's education even before they enter a classroom, impacting their development...
summary.zh: 欧洲的儿童在经历了酷暑的夏天后重返学校。随着气候变暖，一个问题越来越难以忽视：当教室变得异常炎热时，学生如何学习？气候变化甚至可以在儿童踏入教室之前就影响他们的教育，对他们怀孕期间和幼儿时期的发展产生影响。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Children across Europe have returned to school after a summer of extreme heat . As the climate warms, one question is becoming harder to ignore: How can students learn when classrooms become dangerously hot?

Extreme weather is likely to disrupt schooling more often in the years ahead. But climate change can influence a child's education even before they set foot in a classroom.

In research conducted with my colleagues, we examined evidence on exposure to extreme weather during pregnancy and early childhood , including floods, droughts and unusually high temperatures. Such exposure has been linked to lower birth weight, poorer childhood development, starting school later, lower enrollment and completing fewer years of education. The effects can be particularly severe in low- and middle-income countries, where families may have fewer resources to cope with a sudden loss of food, income or access to health care.

The reasons can be painfully simple. When crops fail or floods destroy livelihoods, families may have less money for food and medical care. Pregnant women may eat less, work longer hours or struggle to reach health services. Young children may miss out on adequate nutrition or care while their bodies and brains are developing rapidly.

Research is beginning to show how these early shocks can reverberate years later.

In Ecuador , researchers studied children whose mothers experienced severe flooding caused by El Niño during pregnancy. El Niño is a periodic warming of the tropical Pacific that disrupts weather around the world and can bring unusually heavy rain to Ecuador. Each additional month of flood exposure was associated with lower household income and food consumption in the following year. Children exposed before birth were also more likely to have a low birth weight and anemia. They were shorter for their age and performed less well on some tests of thinking and language development.

In rural Burkina Faso , children exposed before birth to unusually low rainfall scored lower on tests of thinking and learning ability. They were also more likely to start school late, less likely to be enrolled and more likely to work.

Heat appears to pose risks too. A study using data from 29 tropical countries linked climate conditions during pregnancy and early childhood with later educational attainment. In Southeast Asia, children who experienced temperatures far above the local average during these early years were predicted to complete about 1.5 fewer years of schooling than those exposed to average temperatures.

These studies formed part of a wider review...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 经过一个酷热的夏天后，欧洲各地的孩子们已经重返校园。随着气候变暖，一个问题变得越来越难以忽视：当教室变得非常炎热时，学生如何学习？ 未来几年，极端天气可能会更频繁地扰乱学校教育。但气候变化甚至在孩子踏入教室之前就可能影响他们的教育。 在与我的同事进行的研究中，我们检查了怀孕期间和幼儿期暴露于极端天气的证据，包括洪水、干旱和异常高温。这种暴露与出生体重较低、儿童发育较差、入学较晚、入学率较低和完成教育年限较短有关。在低收入和中等收入国家，这种影响可能尤其严重，这些国家的家庭可能没有足够的资源来应对突然失去食物、收入或获得医疗保健的机会。 原因可能非常简单。当农作物歉收或洪水摧毁生计时，家庭用于食品和医疗的钱可能会减少。孕妇可能会吃得更少、工作时间更长或难以获得医疗服务。当幼儿的身体和大脑正在快速发育时，他们可能会错过足够的营养或护理。 研究开始表明这些早期冲击如何在数年后产生影响。 在厄瓜多尔，研究人员对母亲在怀孕期间经历过厄尔尼诺现象造成的严重洪水的儿童进行了研究。厄尔尼诺现象是热带太平洋周期性变暖的现象，它会扰乱世界各地的天气，并可能给厄瓜多尔带来异常大雨。遭受洪水侵袭的时间每增加一个月，下一年的家庭收入和粮食消费就会减少。出生前接触过的儿童也更有可能出现低出生体重和贫血。他们的身高比同龄人要矮，并且在一些思维和语言发展测试中表现较差。 在布基纳法索农村地区，出生前经历过异常低降雨量的儿童在思维和学习能力测试中得分较低。他们上学的可能性也更大，入学的可能性更小，而工作的可能性更大。 高温似乎也会带来风险。一项使用 29 个热带国家数据的研究将怀孕期间和幼儿期的气候条件与后来的教育程度联系起来。在东南亚，早年经历过远高于当地平均气温的儿童预计其受教育年限比那些经历过平均气温的儿童要少约 1.5 年。 这些研究构成了更广泛审查的一部分......

reflection.en: The intense heatwaves described in Europe are not just uncomfortable; they are actively hindering children's ability to learn and develop. This situation underscores the importance of providing a safe and stable environment for the young, as Proverbs 22:6 advises, 'Train up a child in the way he should go.' Ensuring that children can access education...
reflection.zh: 欧洲报道的极端热浪不仅仅是令人不适；它们正在积极阻碍儿童学习和发展的能力。这种情况强调了为年轻人提供安全稳定环境的重要性，正如《箴言》22:6 所建议的：“教养孩童，使他走当行的道。”确保儿童能够接受教育，而不受极端环境条件的阻碍，是这种教养的关键组成部分。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: New iron-bearing compounds could store water near Earth's core
title.zh: 新的含铁化合物可能在地球核心附近储存水

summary.en: Geochemical studies of volcanic rocks from Baffin Island, Canada, and Iceland suggest that some water dating back to Earth's formation may still be preserved deep within the planet. However, it has remained unclear which minerals could store such quantities of water under the extreme conditions of Earth's interior. An...
summary.zh: 对来自加拿大巴芬岛和冰岛的火山岩进行的地球化学研究表明，一些可追溯到地球形成之初的水可能仍保存在地球深处。然而，在地球内部的极端条件下，哪些矿物质能够储存如此大量的水仍然不清楚。一个国际研究小组现在已经合成了两种铁化合物，它们是首次被提出的储存水的现实候选物。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Geochemical studies of volcanic rocks from Baffin Island, Canada, and Iceland suggest that some of the water dating back to Earth's formation may still be preserved deep within the planet. However, it has remained unclear which minerals could store such quantities of water under the extreme conditions of Earth's interior.

An international research team co-led by the University of Bayreuth has now synthesized two iron compounds (Fe₅O₁₂Hₓ and Fe₇O₁₂Hₓ) that represent the first realistic candidates for water storage deep inside Earth.

To achieve this, the researchers used so-called diamond anvil cells. In these devices, tiny samples are compressed between two diamonds and then heated with lasers.

The resulting conditions resemble those found several thousand kilometers beneath Earth's surface, with pressures of 78 to 198 gigapascals and temperatures of 2,400 to 2,800 kelvin (approximately 2,100 to 2,500 degrees Celsius, 3,800 to 4,500 degrees Fahrenheit).

Using synchrotron X-ray radiation, the researchers were able to identify chemical compositions and crystal structures that formed under these conditions. The new compounds formed not only from deliberately water-rich mixtures but also from samples containing almost no water.

"Apparently, even very small amounts of hydrogen are sufficient to stabilize these highly hydrated iron compounds," says Professor Leonid Dubrovinsky of the Bavarian Research Institute of Experimental Geochemistry and Geophysics (BGI) at the University of Bayreuth.

One possible reservoir for water dating back to Earth's formation is an ancient basal magma ocean that crystallized above the core-mantle boundary. As it cooled, its remaining melt would have become enriched in iron and water, precisely the ingredients required to form the newly identified minerals.

"These minerals could also store water that is transported deep into Earth by the movement of tectonic plates. Because the compounds are very dense, they would likely remain near the core-mantle boundary and retain water there over geological timescales," says Dr. Man Lianjie, one of the authors and a former doctoral student at BGI.

The compound Fe₅O₁₂Hₓ is particularly rich in hydrogen. According to the researchers' calculations, a concentration of only about 1% of this mineral within the mantle could be sufficient to store a large proportion of the estimated hydrogen inventory of the silicate Earth. The mineral is unlikely to occur uniformly throughout the mantle, however, and would probably be concentrated in localized regions.

In the experiments, formation of the oxyhydroxides...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 对加拿大巴芬岛和冰岛火山岩的地球化学研究表明，一些可以追溯到地球形成时期的水可能仍然保存在地球深处。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些矿物质可以在地球内部的极端条件下储存如此大量的水。 由拜罗伊特大学共同领导的一个国际研究小组现已合成了两种铁化合物（Fe₅O₁当Hₓ和Fe₇O₁当Hₓ），它们代表了地球深处储水的第一个现实候选者。 为了实现这一目标，研究人员使用了所谓的金刚石砧细胞。在这些设备中，微小的样品被压缩在两颗钻石之间，然后用激光加热。 由此产生的条件类似于在地球表面以下数千公里处发现的条件，压力为 78 至 198 吉帕斯卡，温度为 2,400 至 2,800 开尔文（约 2,100 至 2,500 摄氏度、3,800 至 4,500 华氏度）。 利用同步加速器 X 射线辐射，研究人员能够识别在这些条件下形成的化学成分和晶体结构。这些新化合物不仅是由故意富含水的混合物形成的，而且是由几乎不含水的样品形成的。 拜罗伊特大学巴伐利亚实验地球化学和地球物理研究所 (BGI) 的 Leonid Dubrovinsky 教授表示：“显然，即使是非常少量的氢也足以稳定这些高度水合的铁化合物。” 一种可能的水库可以追溯到地球形成之初，是在核幔边界上方结晶的古老基底岩浆海洋。当它冷却时，其剩余的熔体会富含铁和水，而这正是形成新发现的矿物质所需的成分。 “这些矿物还可以储存通过板块运动输送到地球深处的水。由于这些化合物非常致密，它们很可能保留在地核-地幔边界附近，并在地质时间尺度上保留水在那里，”作者之一、华大基因前博士生满连杰博士说。 化合物Fe 5 O 12 H 3 富含氢。根据研究人员的计算，这种矿物在地幔中的浓度仅为 1% 左右，就足以储存硅酸盐地球估计氢库存的很大一部分。然而，这种矿物不太可能均匀地分布在整个地幔中，并且可能集中在局部区域。 在实验中，羟基氧化物的形成...

reflection.en: Scientists are uncovering new possibilities about Earth's deep interior, suggesting that water from its very formation might still be held within. This discovery reminds us that even as we explore the planet's hidden depths, there is so much we do not yet understand. It echoes the ancient question, 'Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?'...
reflection.zh: 科学家们正在揭示关于地球内部的新可能性，表明其形成之初的水可能仍被储存在其中。这一发现提醒我们，即使我们探索地球的隐秘深处，仍有许多我们尚未理解的事物。这呼应了古老的提问：“我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？”邀请我们以谦卑和惊奇之心面对造物主的精妙设计。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: In Nepal, climate adaptation starts with what communities already know
title.zh: 在尼泊尔，气候适应始于社区的已知

summary.en: A catastrophic flood along the Nepal-China border killed over 1,400 people and left nearly 6,000 missing, devastating communities and infrastructure. This event highlights the urgent need for Himalayan countries to prepare for rapidly unfolding environmental hazards that can cross national borders, prompting questions...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔-中国边境的一场灾难性洪水造成1400多人死亡，近6000人失踪，摧毁了社区和基础设施。这一事件凸显了喜马拉雅国家为应对可能迅速发生并跨越国界的まさかの環境灾害做准备的紧迫性，并引发了关于有效气候适应策略的疑问。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The catastrophic flood along the Nepal–China border that killed more than 1,400 people and left nearly 6,000 people missing devastated communities and infrastructure and renewed questions about how Himalayan countries prepare for environmental hazards that can unfold rapidly and cross-national borders.

For University of Michigan researcher Rajiv Ghimire, those questions connect to a challenge he has studied in Nepal for years: Climate adaptation may be shaped by national policies and scientific expertise, but ultimately it has to work in the places where people experience environmental change in their everyday lives.

Ghimire, a lecturer at U-M's School for Environment and Sustainability, and Arizona State University's Netra Chhetri examined Nepal's Local Adaptation Plans of Action, or LAPA, to understand how local knowledge can be incorporated into formal climate adaptation and what happens when communities are given a role in deciding how to respond.

Their study, published in Ecology and Society , suggests that some of the most useful starting points for climate adaptation may already exist within communities. But turning that knowledge into effective policy requires money, institutional support and attention to who gets to participate in local decision-making. This work is also part of a special feature in progress on Everyday Adaptations to Climate Change, which includes a collection of 15 articles that Ghimire contributed to as a guest editor.

Nepal introduced LAPA as a way to connect national climate policy with the experiences and priorities of people at the local level.

Ghimire and Chhetri examined 65 local adaptation plans covering 11 districts, interviewed 45 local stakeholders and spoke with 15 people involved in climate adaptation at the national and regional levels. What they found complicates the idea that adaptation necessarily begins with a new technology or intervention.

Communities identified drought, untimely rainfall, drying water sources, floods and landslides, crop pests and diseases, forest fires and declining agricultural production among the changes affecting their lives. Their responses included improving irrigation, conserving water sources, planting trees, introducing improved seeds and crops, protecting drinking-water systems and changing livestock practices.

Of local respondents, 78% said the adaptation activities proposed through LAPA were practices that already existed in their communities.

Ghimire and Chhetri describe this as "everyday adaptation," the adjustments people continually make as they respond to environmental, economic...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 尼泊尔和中国边境发生的灾难性洪水造成 1,400 多人死亡，近 6,000 人失踪，社区和基础设施遭到破坏，并再次引发人们对喜马拉雅国家如何应对可能迅速蔓延的跨国界环境危害的疑问。 对于密歇根大学研究员拉吉夫·吉米尔来说，这些问题与他多年来在尼泊尔研究的一个挑战有关：气候适应可能由国家政策和科学专业知识决定，但最终必须在人们日常生活中经历环境变化的地方发挥作用。 密歇根大学环境与可持续发展学院讲师 Ghimire 和亚利桑那州立大学的 Netra Chhetri 研究了尼泊尔的当地适应行动计划 (LAPA)，以了解如何将当地知识纳入正式的气候适应中，以及当社区在决定如何应对时发挥作用时会发生什么。 他们发表在《生态与社会》上的研究表明，一些最有用的气候适应起点可能已经存在于社区内。但将这些知识转化为有效的政策需要资金、机构支持以及对谁可以参与当地决策的关注。这项工作也是《日常适应气候变化》专题的一部分，其中包括吉米尔作为客座编辑撰写的 15 篇文章集。 尼泊尔引入 LAPA 作为将国家气候政策与地方人民的经验和优先事项联系起来的一种方式。 Ghimire 和 Chhetri 检查了覆盖 11 个地区的 65 个地方适应计划，采访了 45 个当地利益相关者，并与 15 名参与国家和地区层面气候适应工作的人士进行了交谈。他们的发现使适应必然始于新技术或干预措施的想法变得复杂。 社区认为，干旱、不合时宜的降雨、水源干涸、洪水和山体滑坡、农作物病虫害、森林火灾和农业产量下降等影响他们生活的变化。他们的应对措施包括改善灌溉、保护水源、植树、引进改良种子和农作物、保护饮用水系统和改变畜牧业做法。 在当地受访者中，78% 的人表示通过 LAPA 提出的适应活动是他们社区中已经存在的做法。 吉米尔和切特里将其描述为“日常适应”，即人们在应对环境、经济时不断做出的调整……

reflection.en: The news from Nepal speaks of creation groaning, as described in Romans 8:22. The devastating flood, which claimed over 1,400 lives and left thousands missing, is a stark reminder of the fragility of our world and the impact of environmental hazards. It calls us to consider how we live in and care for the earth, acknowledging its brokenness while seeking...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔的消息令人痛心，正如罗马书8:22所描述的，万物都在呻吟。这场造成1400多人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水， starkly提醒我们世界的脆弱性以及环境灾害的影响。它促使我们反思如何生活在地球上并关爱它，承认它的破碎，同时寻求适应和建立韧性的方法。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – video
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——视频

summary.en: A study, which found that wealthy individuals are more likely to engage in unethical behavior, was a winner of the Ig Nobel prizes. The research suggests potential reasons for this phenomenon, alongside other award-winning studies.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，富裕人士更有可能做出不道德的行为，并获得了2026年搞笑诺贝尔奖。该研究探讨了这一现象的潜在原因，并介绍了其他获奖研究。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了对接吻的生物力学定义继续阅读...

reflection.en: This research, honored by the Ig Nobel prizes, raises questions about the relationship between wealth and morality. It prompts us to consider whether the pursuit of material gain can sometimes overshadow ethical considerations, echoing the ancient wisdom that one cannot serve both God and Mammon.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖所表彰的研究，引发了关于财富与道德之间关系的疑问。它促使我们思考，对物质财富的追求是否有时会掩盖道德考量，这呼应了古老的智慧：人不能同时事奉神和玛门。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: 'River is flowing better than it has for 25 years'
title.zh: 25年来河流状况最佳

summary.en: The River Deben is flowing better than it has in 25 years following major restoration efforts. Excavation and tree removal, part of a community and multi-agency initiative, have improved water flow after a weir collapse and bridge damage caused water levels to drop significantly.
summary.zh: 经过大规模修复工程后，德本河的河流状况比过去25年来都要好。挖掘和移除树木是多方机构和社区共同努力的一部分，在堰坝倒塌和桥梁损坏导致水位大幅下降后，这些工作改善了河流的流速。

body.en:
A river is flowing better than it has for a quarter of a century after a major restoration but the next stage of works will be "really critical", according to a parish councillor.

Water levels in the River Deben in Suffolk dropped by more than a metre after heavy rain caused a weir structure at Ufford, near Woodbridge, to fall away and a bridge to partially collapse.

While they are still to be fixed, water in the river is again running freely after a multi-agency and community effort saw vital excavations and tree removal take place.

Councillor David Finley, river warden at Ufford Parish Council, said it was a "really exciting moment to actually see the water flowing" again.

"This section of the river used to be cleaned out every five to 10 years, so it's not been like this for 25 years," he said.

"Now, you can see gravel bits and silt bits, and so it's actually creating a really potentially dynamic river."

The collapse in April caused a water-filled crater known as Ufford Hole to drain on to surrounding land, including on a side channel towards the East Suffolk railway line.

It happened after tree roots grew into the weir, which subsequently "fell to pieces", Finley said, resulting in "all the water" rushing towards the Hawkeswade/Lower Ufford Bridge which "cracked" it.

The Essex & Suffolk Rivers Trust said it caused "significant damage to habitats along a large stretch of the river".

A wooden walkway next to the bridge, which allows people to follow a footpath on the river bank, had to be closed off and it is still awaiting repair.

Trevor Gill, from the Lower Deben Riparian Owners Group, said the collapse had a detrimental effect on biodiversity.

"It had a really big impact on nature, but also on people who love this, people who've been fishing and swimming here for decades," he said.

"People were worried about fish dying, which did happen, and it was pretty barren.

"What we've done so far shows people that we are here to get behind this problem and fix it."

After the incident, councils and a consortium of landowners and farmers worked with the Environment Agency and others to form an action plan.

The first phase of that focused on clearing the dried-out channel from Old Melton Mill to Ufford Hole to allow water to flow back to the mill.

Now that has been achieved, attention has turned to repairing the weir before the "winter flood" and also the footpath to restore access.

"The really critical bit is getting this weir sorted out so the water doesn't just accelerate the channel and create real problems further down the river," Finley said.

body.zh: 一位教区议员表示，经过重大修复后，河流的流量比四分之一个世纪以来的情况要好，但下一阶段的工程将“非常关键”。 大雨导致伍德布里奇附近的乌福德的一个堰结构脱落，一座桥梁部分倒塌，萨福克郡德本河的水位下降了一米多。 虽然它们仍有待修复，但在多机构和社区的努力下进行了重要的挖掘和树木清除后，河水再次自由流动。 乌福德教区议会河流管理员、议员大卫·芬利表示，“再次看到水流流动真是令人兴奋的时刻”。 他说：“这一段河以前每五到十年就会被清理一次，所以已经有 25 年没有这样了。” “现在，你可以看到砾石和淤泥，因此它实际上正在创造一条真正具有潜在活力的河流。” 4 月份的塌陷导致一个名为 Ufford Hole 的充满水的火山口流到周围的土地上，包括通往东萨福克铁路线的侧通道。 芬利说，树根长进堰后，堰随后“碎裂”，导致“所有的水”涌向霍克斯瓦德/下乌福德大桥，导致堰“破裂”。 埃塞克斯和萨福克河信托基金表示，它“对沿河大片河段的栖息地造成了严重破坏”。 桥旁的一条木制走道允许人们沿着河岸的人行道行走，但不得不关闭，目前仍在等待修复。 下德本河岸业主小组的特雷弗·吉尔表示，塌方对生物多样性产生了不利影响。 “它对自然产生了巨大的影响，也对热爱这里的人们，几十年来一直在这里钓鱼和游泳的人们产生了巨大的影响，”他说。 “人们担心鱼类死亡，这种情况确实发生了，而且那里非常贫瘠。 “到目前为止，我们所做的事情向人们表明，我们是来支持这个问题并解决它的。” 事件发生后，议会以及土地所有者和农民组成的财团与环境局和其他机构合作制定了一项行动计划。 第一阶段的重点是清理从老梅尔顿磨坊到乌福德洞的干涸通道，让水流回磨坊。 既然已经实现了这一目标，人们的注意力就转向在“冬季洪水”到来之前修复堰以及恢复通道的人行道。 芬利说：“真正关键的一点是解决这个堰，这样水就不会加速河道流速，并在河流下游造成真正的问题。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注萨福克新闻。 河流水位因干旱而下降。视频，00:04:00 河流水位因干旱而暴跌

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see the River Deben flowing freely again after significant restoration work. This success, achieved through collaborative effort, reminds us of the goodness of creation and our role in its care. May this restoration inspire continued stewardship and a deep appreciation for the natural world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 看到德本河经过大规模修复工程后再次自由流淌，令人鼓舞。这项通过共同努力取得的成功，提醒我们受造物的良善以及我们在其照管中的作用。愿这次修复能激励我们继续尽责，并深深地欣赏雅伟所造的自然世界。

title.en: Scientists discover a powerful new antivenom hidden in rattlesnake blood
title.zh: 科学家在响尾蛇血液中发现强效新抗蛇毒剂

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from several dangerous snake species. Laboratory tests showed these mixtures were approximately 10 times more potent than a current commercial antivenom, suggesting a...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，响尾蛇血液中天然存在的毒素阻断蛋白组合能够有效中和多种危险蛇类的毒液。实验室测试表明，这些混合物的效力约为当前市售抗蛇毒剂的10倍，为治疗蛇咬伤开辟了一条有前景的新途径。

body.en:
University of Maryland researchers have identified a promising new way to treat venomous snakebites by borrowing from snakes' own natural defenses. Their approach uses toxin-blocking proteins that western diamondback rattlesnakes evolved to protect themselves from venom.

By combining specific proteins found in rattlesnake blood, the researchers achieved unusually strong protection against venom from several dangerous snake species.

The study was led by Distinguished University Professor of BiologySean B. Carroll and published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences . The findings could help researchers develop more powerful antivenoms for deadly snakebites, which remain a major health threat in some regions of the world.

"This is one of those great stories when nature has already solved a problem we've been grappling with for decades," said Carroll, who also holds the Andrew and Mary Balo and Nicholas and Susan Simon Endowed Chair at UMD.

Snakebite is considered one of the world's most neglected tropical diseases. According to the World Health Organization, venomous snakes kill an estimated 80,000 to 140,000 people annually, while hundreds of thousands of survivors are left with permanent disabilities. Many of those affected live in rural areas where effective antivenom can be difficult to obtain.

Existing antivenoms save lives, but they also have major drawbacks. They are typically produced by exposing large animals to snake venom and then collecting the antibodies those animals generate. Manufacturing these treatments can be costly, their quality and effectiveness can vary, and they may not work equally well against the many different toxins found in venom from different snake species. They can also cause serious immune reactions.

Those limitations have pushed scientists to search for better options. In this case, the researchers turned to snakes themselves for clues.

"We've known from anecdotes for 100 years that vipers tend to be resistant to their own venom," Carroll said. "But for a long time, nobody knew what exactly was circulating in their blood that protected them."

In 2022, Carroll's laboratory found part of the answer: a protein called FETUA-3. The researchers discovered that it could block the activity of many metalloproteinase toxins found in western diamondback rattlesnake venom. It could also bind to and inhibit toxins from the venoms of several other rattlesnake species.

"Here was evolution's way for snakes to protect themselves from accidental self-envenomation," he said, which prompted a follow-up question. "Why rely on horse antibodies when nature has packaged an effective antidote right there in the snake?"

For the new research, co-authors including Elda Sánchez, director of the National Natural...
body.zh: 马里兰大学的研究人员利用蛇自身的自然防御能力，发现了一种治疗毒蛇咬伤的有前途的新方法。他们的方法使用西方小菜斑响尾蛇进化来的毒素阻断蛋白来保护自己免受毒液的侵害。 通过结合响尾蛇血液中发现的特定蛋白质，研究人员获得了针对几种危险蛇类毒液的异常强大的保护作用。 该研究由杰出大学生物学教授肖恩·B·卡罗尔（Sean B. Carroll）领导，并发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这些发现可以帮助研究人员开发出更强大的抗蛇毒血清来治疗致命的蛇咬伤，蛇咬伤仍然是世界某些地区的主要健康威胁。 “这是一个伟大的故事，大自然已经解决了我们几十年来一直在努力解决的问题，”卡罗尔说，他也是马里兰大学安德鲁和玛丽巴洛以及尼古拉斯和苏珊西蒙捐赠主席。 蛇咬伤被认为是世界上最被忽视的热带疾病之一。据世界卫生组织称，毒蛇每年导致约 80,000 至 140,000 人死亡，数十万幸存者留下永久性残疾。许多受影响者生活在农村地区，那里很难获得有效的抗蛇毒血清。 现有的抗蛇毒血清可以挽救生命，但它们也有重大缺点。它们通常是通过将大型动物暴露于蛇毒中，然后收集这些动物产生的抗体来产生的。制造这些治疗方法可能成本高昂，其质量和效果也各不相同，而且它们对于不同蛇类毒液中发现的多种不同毒素的效果可能不同。它们还会引起严重的免疫反应。 这些限制促使科学家寻找更好的选择。在这种情况下，研究人员转向蛇本身寻找线索。 卡罗尔说：“我们从 100 年来的轶事中得知，毒蛇往往对自己的毒液有抵抗力。” “但很长一段时间，没有人知道他们的血液中到底循环着什么来保护他们。” 2022 年，卡罗尔的实验室找到了部分答案：一种名为 FETUA-3 的蛋白质。研究人员发现，它可以阻止西方小菜斑响尾蛇毒液中发现的许多金属蛋白酶毒素的活性。它还可以结合并抑制其他几种响尾蛇物种的毒液中的毒素。 “这是蛇的进化方式，可以保护自己免受意外的自我毒害，”他说，这引发了一个后续问题。 “当大自然已经在蛇体内包装了有效的解毒剂时，为什么还要依赖马抗体呢？” 对于这项新研究，合著者包括国家自然科学中心主任埃尔达·桑切斯……

reflection.en: The natural world is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design and wisdom. In this case, the very creatures that possess dangerous venom also hold the key to its neutralization within their own biology. This discovery reminds us that by observing and understanding creation, we can uncover profound solutions and appreciate the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 大自然是雅伟精妙设计和智慧的明证。在此案例中，拥有剧毒的生物本身也蕴藏着中和毒液的关键。这一发现提醒我们，通过观察和理解受造界，我们可以揭示深刻的解决方案，并欣赏创造者的奇思妙想。

title.en: Your personality may be more genetic than scientists realized
title.zh: 你的个性可能比科学家们意识到的更具遗传性

summary.en: A study has identified over 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits, suggesting a significant genetic link between personality and various life outcomes such as health, longevity, careers, and income. The research involved an international collaboration analyzing data from 46 cohorts...
summary.zh: 一项研究确定了与“大五”人格特质相关的1200多个基因变异，表明人格与健康、寿命、职业和收入等多种生活结果之间存在显著的遗传联系。该研究涉及一项国际合作，分析了来自全球46个研究队列的数据。

body.en:
An international team of scientists has identified more than 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits. The findings also suggest that many of the same genetic patterns connected to personality are related to a wide range of life outcomes, including health, longevity, education, careers, and income.

The study, led by the Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium, brought together data from 46 research cohorts around the world. Participants provided DNA samples and completed questionnaires designed to measure the Big Five personality traits: openness to experience, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism.

These traits describe relatively stable patterns in how people tend to think, feel, and behave. Researchers compared participants' genetic data with differences in their personality scores to identify genetic variants associated with each trait.

"There is no single 'personality gene,'" said Ted Schwaba, lead author of this study and faculty at MSU's Department of Psychology. "Personality traits are associated with many genetic variants, but even the largest effects of individual genetic variants are still very small. However, even though any individual genetic variant makes very little difference in personality, the effects of many variants together can be more sizeable."

Although the influence of any one genetic variant was tiny, the researchers found that their combined effects were more substantial and consistent. The genetic patterns also appeared to hold across very different groups of people.

For instance, variants associated with extraversion in a young adult living in the Netherlands could also help predict extraversion in an older retired adult in the United States. By using methods that compared relatives with one another, the team found evidence that these genetic associations could not simply be explained by growing up in the same environment.

Even so, genetics is only part of the picture. The findings also reinforced the important role that a person's environment plays in shaping personality.

The researchers found that genetic variants associated with personality overlap with genetic patterns connected to many other areas of life. These include mental and physical health, longevity, education, career choices and outcomes, as well as the way people are viewed by those close to them.

Some of the links involved everyday habits. Genetic variants associated with conscientiousness were also related to being more active during the daytime. Meanwhile, variants associated with openness to experience and extraversion were connected with a greater tendency to be a night owl.

The results also highlight how genetics and environment can interact with one another rather than operating...
body.zh: 一个国际科学家团队已鉴定出 1,200 多种与“大五人格”特征相关的基因变异。研究结果还表明，许多与性格相关的相同遗传模式与广泛的生活结果相关，包括健康、长寿、教育、职业和收入。 这项研究由复兴人格基因组学联盟 (Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium) 领导，汇集了来自全球 46 个研究队列的数据。参与者提供了 DNA 样本并完成了旨在衡量五大人格特征的调查问卷：开放性、责任心、外向性、宜人性和神经质。 这些特征描述了人们如何思考、感受和行为的相对稳定的模式。研究人员将参与者的遗传数据与他们的性格评分差异进行比较，以确定与每个特征相关的遗传变异。 “不存在单一的‘人格基因’，”这项研究的主要作者、密歇根州立大学心理学系的教员泰德·施瓦巴 (Ted Schwaba) 说。 “人格特征与许多遗传变异有关，但即使单个遗传变异的最大影响仍然很小。然而，即使任何单个遗传变异对人格的影响很小，但许多变异加在一起的影响可能会更大。” 尽管任何一种遗传变异的影响都很微小，但研究人员发现它们的综合影响更为实质性和一致。这些遗传模式似乎也适用于非常不同的人群。 例如，与生活在荷兰的年轻人的外向性相关的变异也可以帮助预测美国老年退休成年人的外向性。通过使用相互比较亲属的方法，研究小组发现证据表明这些遗传关联不能简单地用在同一环境中长大来解释。 即便如此，遗传学只是问题的一部分。研究结果还强调了一个人的环境在塑造人格方面所发挥的重要作用。 研究人员发现，与性格相关的遗传变异与与生活许多其他领域相关的遗传模式重叠。这些因素包括身心健康、寿命、教育、职业选择和结果，以及亲近的人看待人们的方式。 有些链接涉及日常习惯。与责任心相关的基因变异也与白天更加活跃有关。与此同时，与开放经验和外向性相关的变异与夜猫子的更大倾向有关。 结果还强调了遗传和环境如何相互作用而不是操作......

reflection.en: This research reveals a deep genetic connection to our personalities, suggesting that much of who we are is woven into our very being. It echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself, in its intricate design, speaks of the Creator's profound knowledge and the complex tapestry of human life.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了与我们个性深厚的遗传联系，表明我们很大程度上是被编织进我们自身的存在中的。它呼应了古老的智慧，即创造本身，以其错综复杂的设计，诉说着造物主深邃的知识和人类生命的复杂织锦。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy may have an unexpected mental health benefit
title.zh: 奥泽平与韦戈维可能带来意想不到的心理健康益处

summary.en: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, has been linked in a large Swedish study to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization among nearly 15,000 individuals with bipolar disorder. Researchers hypothesize that its effects on inflammation and biological pathways in the brain may contribute to...
summary.zh: 在奥泽平（Ozempic）和韦戈维（Wegovy）中发现的司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）成分，在一项对近15,000名双相情感障碍患者的大型瑞典研究中，与精神科住院风险降低21%相关。研究人员推测，其对炎症和大脑生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，尽管其他GLP-1类药物未显示出相同的关联性。

body.en: Semaglutide, the drug behind Ozempic and Wegovy, may have benefits that extend well beyond weight loss and diabetes. In a large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder, its use was linked to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization. Researchers think effects on inflammation and brain-related biological pathways could help stabilize mood, though other GLP-1 drugs did not show the same association.
body.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 背后的药物索马鲁肽的益处可能远远超出减肥和糖尿病的范围。瑞典一项针对近 15,000 名双相情感障碍患者的大型研究显示，使用该药物可将精神病住院风险降低 21%。研究人员认为，对炎症和大脑相关生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，但其他 GLP-1 药物并未显示出相同的关联。

reflection.en: This news offers a glimmer of hope for individuals navigating the complexities of bipolar disorder. The potential for a medication, primarily known for weight management, to also contribute to mental stability and reduce psychiatric hospitalizations is a significant development. It reminds us that healing can come through unexpected avenues, and that...
reflection.zh: 这一消息为那些应对双相情感障碍复杂性的人们带来了一线希望。一种主要以体重管理而闻名的药物，竟然也能帮助稳定精神状态并减少精神科住院，这是一个重要的进展。它提醒我们，治愈可能来自意想不到的途径，并且持续的研究不断揭示支持心理健康的新方法。
